newsitem.title: CANADA: Talisman, Gulf Cda get credit line.
newsitem.headline: Talisman, Gulf Cda get credit line.

text.p: Talisman Energy Inc and Gulf Canada Resources Ltd said on Thursday they signed a project financing deal with 19 lenders, who will provide up to US$450 million for the companies' Corridor Block gas project.
The financing will be provided on an indirect limited-sponsor-recourse basis.

Talisman and Gulf Canada said the loan facility, which would be used to drill additional wells and construction of field and plant facilities, was arranged by ITOCHU Corp, The Sumitomo Bank Ltd, Chase Manhattan Bank and DKB Merchant Bank (Singapore) Ltd.

The Corridor Block project will produce and ship roughly 300 million cubic feet per day of gas from the Corridor Block Production Sharing Contract area in south Sumatra, chiefly for use as fuel at the Duri steamflood operated by PT Caltex Pacific Indonesia and for power generation at Batam Island.
At Duri, the gas will displace approximately 50,000 barrels per day of crude oil that is being used to generate steam for enhanced oil recovery.

The displaced crude oil will be received as payment in kind for the Corridor gas, and an agreement has been signed with a subsidiary of ITOCHU to purchase all of such oil for a nine-year period at prices based on Indonesian crude oil prices, the companies said.
